subject.title: feat(preview): polish workbench demos, foundations, and home grid

question: Should the canonical `--oc-radius-surface`, `--oc-radius-control`, and `--oc-radius-inset` defaults change from the current square profile to the Kumo profile for all design-system consumers?
rationale: This is a published shared-token contract decision, not a preview-only implementation detail; repository policy requires shared behavior to be proven across consumers before it becomes canonical.

options.title: Scope Kumo to preview
options.body: Restore the public radius defaults and keep the Kumo presentation in preview or an explicit opt-in theme until cross-consumer validation exists.

options.title: Adopt a versioned contract change
options.body: Approve the new defaults deliberately, document downstream visual impact, and validate representative consumer surfaces before release.

recommendation.title: Scope Kumo to preview
recommendation.body: Restore the public radius defaults and keep the Kumo presentation in preview or an explicit opt-in theme until cross-consumer validation exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-member contributor who proposed both the preview direction and the canonical token changes.
